Subject: Hotpath + Archive bundle questions

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the hotpath latency and dashboards looked promising. Procurement asked me to get a clearer picture of commercial options for the observability add-ons (hotpath retention, long-term archive, and advanced dashboards). Specifically: 

- Can you provide 12‑mo and 36‑mo pricing for (A) hotpath + 90d retention; (B) hotpath + 1yr archive; (C) a hybrid where hotpath is slab-based and archive is metered?
- Will there be an applied discount if we commit to a 24‑month reserved capacity for serving?
- Any pilot credits or PO process we should be aware of?

Attaching our SOW draft for reference. Looking to land an internal approval by 11/13 — can you turn around a counterproposal by EOD Monday?

Thanks,
Alice

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Hotpath + Archive bundle questions

Hi Alice — great to hear and thanks for the SOW, that helps. High level answers up front and then I can send a short counterproposal: 

1) Pricing constructs we recommend
- Option A (Hotpath + 90d): Slab-based hotpath (tokens/sec capacity tiers) + fixed dashboard seats. 90d retention included in slab price.
- Option B (Hotpath + 1yr archive): Slab hotpath + metered archive ($/GB-month) with tiered volume discounts.
- Option C (Hybrid): Hotpath slab + archive metered, with a committed-archive discount if you commit to 12+ months of archive spend.

2) Discounts
- For a 24‑month serving commit we typically offer a 15% discount on slab charges, and we can stack a 10–25% archive discount depending on archive commitment.

3) Pilot / PO path
- We offer a 3‑month pilot with $10k credits against add-ons for first‑time pilots. PO goes to our finance portal (I'll include the link).

To be precise I need: expected average hotpath RPS (or tokens/sec) and an estimate of monthly archive ingress + retention GB. Can you share a quick usage snapshot?

I'll draft a one‑page counterproposal Monday and include example numbers across the three options so procurement has a clean comparison.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Manager — Redwood Inference

Connor — adding a few technical/commercial notes you can fold into the counterproposal: 

- Hotpath pricing should reflect peak slot sizing (we price by reserved hot slots) and continuous batching savings; call out expected tail latency SLA and included prefix cache hit rates.
- Archive: meters on compressed GB/month (we apply server-side compression estimates ~2.6x), charge for retrieval egress when data is restored into hotpath.
- Dashboards: seat + dashboard-delta pricing (we can grant 5 free seats in pilot).

Suggested structure for the counterproposal doc: short summary table (Option A/B/C), assumptions (RPS, average seq len, compress ratio), line items with list price, commit discount, pilot credits, and PO instructions.

I've attached a quick pricing sheet you can use for numbers — I put conservative compression and a sample 500GB/mo ingest baseline.

Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Pricing — Redwood Inference

Connor / team — thanks for the quick turns. A couple clarifications from procurement: 

- We expect ~600GB ingest per month (pre-compression) with peaks during EHR sync windows (need hotpath bursting).
- Our legal team will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and data residency notes for any archive retention >12 months. Can you include the SOC2 link and the data residency options in the counterproposal?
- PO timeline: we need a final commercial by 11/16 to submit for Dec budget approval.

Also, we're more price-sensitive on the archive; if you can show a committed archive discount (first year ~25%) with a path to step-down pricing in year 2, that will get this moving.

Alice

Team — looping you in. Draft counteroffer below that I plan to send to Alice tomorrow morning; want a quick green light and sign-off on the archive discount math.

--- Forwarded proposal (draft) ---
Summary: 3-option commercial for Greenline Health
1) Option A — Hotpath + 90d retention
   - Hotpath reserved slab: $24,000/month (Tier 2, up to 2.5k tokens/sec)
   - Dashboards: 10 seats included, additional seats $35/seat/month
   - 24‑month serving commit discount: 15% off slab

2) Option B — Hotpath + 1yr archive
   - Hotpath slab: $24,000/month
   - Archive: $0.045/GB-month (compressed) -> est. $0.017/GB-month after typical volume tiers 
   - First-year committed archive discount: 25% off archive list if committed to 12+ months

3) Option C — Hybrid (recommended)
   - Hotpath slab (as above) + metered archive with stepped discounts tied to 12/24 month commits
   - Pilot: $10k credit applied to add-ons; 3 months free dashboard seats (up to 5)

Assumptions: 600GB/mo ingest (pre-compression), 2.6x compression, retrieval egress charged separately at standard egress rates.

Next steps: I plan to include SOC2 evidence link, our data residency options, and the DocuSign PO template. If we approve archive discount at 25% for year 1 (with year 2 step-down to 10%), I will send to Alice and CC procurement.

Approve?

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Manager — Redwood Inference
